label: No infinite SERIES_OF_CAUSES_4 series, from 97f5850f and the sense inclusion
description: Non-transcription conditional derivation: if the per se series of efficient causes on SERIES_OF_CAUSES_3 cannot go on to infinity (97f5850f) and every SERIES_OF_CAUSES_4 link is a SERIES_OF_CAUSES_3 link (the open sense bridge), then the existential series cannot go on to infinity. So, given the sense bridge, the existential no-regress premise is the weaker of the two: the existential relation is the narrower one. The order is not definitional: without the sense bridge they are independent (second conjunct of senseInclusionControls: 97f5850f holds with CausesAsCaused empty while the existential series has a two-cycle), and the existential premise never gives 97f5850f (secundaSplitLimit, attached to the PER_SE_5 argument). senseInclusionControls also drop 97f5850f and give a nonvacuous interpretation. No strengthens relation is registered, because the order needs the open sense bridge.
